title: ever LILOU|Ruffle Sleeve Chiffon Midi Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with this stunning Rhinestone Embellished Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Mother Dress! Featuring delicate ruffle sleeves and sparkling rhinestone accents, this dress flows beautifully with every step. Perfect for formal events or glamorous nights out, it promises to make you the center of attention!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
